g.text: Four boundary-specific syntheses. Existing mechanisms are not automatically validated in the material-flow domain.

g.text: B aliases identify domain/enabling papers; numeric 004/016/018 labels identify DTUM studies. Full identifiers, DOIs and rationales are in the CSVs.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: Dashed arrows are reviewer synthesis/proposals. Missing direct evidence is retained; no complete deployed S1–S5 system is claimed.
